description: `setDesiredAPY(bps)` is `onlyOwner` with no upper bound on `bps`. The committed value flows directly into `phUSDPerSecond = totalStaked * desiredAPYBps / 10000 / SECONDS_PER_YEAR`, which is then minted to stakers via `phUSD.mint`. The only friction is a two-step gate with a 100-block window (~20 min on L1). Owner can therefore inflict arbitrary phUSD inflation on the stablecoin (subject to phUSD's external minter authorization), which is more than the usual centralization framing — it is a direct value-leak lever on an external asset. Matches CENTRALIZATION-ADMIN (`onlyOwner` on a critical parameter). Pattern note says C4 treats centralization as Low/QA unless rug-enabling; the combination of "no cap" + "direct mint authority on an external stablecoin" tips this into medium territory in the candidate stage. Final severity is the classifier's call.
vulnerableConditionsMet: Parameter directly controls mint pressure on an external token
Only on-chain friction is a 100-block soft delay
